user.title: Dash-Bored
user.description: Adds a Dash-Bored page to the sidebar: your house as a newspaper, written from your areas and the lights, switches, covers and locks in them. Nothing needs setting up. The same page is available as a dashboard card, Dash-Bored Gazette.

init.title: Dash-Bored: the house
init.description: These apply to every Dash-Bored page and card. To leave a room or a device out altogether, give it the label Dash-Bored hide.
